metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: This question is about comparing tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels in Hong Kong between two time periods: - Period 1: February 10-25, 2020 - Period 2: January 1-20, 2020 I need to use satellite data that measures tropospheric NO₂. The best source for this is the Sentinel-5P TROPOMI instrument, which has a NO₂ band. Data collection: - Use Sentinel-5P collection: "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2" - Filter by date ranges for both periods - Filter by geometry for Hong Kong Processing: - Calculate mean NO₂ for each period - Compare if February mean < January mean Validation: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Check if calculations are valid (C3) Hong Kong geometry: I'll use a polygon around Hong Kong area. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions hong_kong = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [113.8, 22.1], [114.5, 22.1], [114.5, 22.6], [113.8, 22.6], [113.8, 22.1] ]) # Period 1: Feb 10-25, 2020 feb_start = '2020-02-10' feb_end = '2020-02-25' # Period 2: Jan 1-20, 2020 jan_start = '2020-01-01' jan_end = '2020-01-20' # 2. Data Acquisition feb_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) \ .filterBounds(hong_kong) jan_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) \ .filterBounds(hong_kong) # Check for empty collections feb_count = feb_col.size().getInfo() jan_count = jan_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Feb Images: {feb_count}, Jan Images: {jan_count}") if feb_count == 0 or jan_count == 0: print("C1") else: # Create mean composites feb_mean = feb_col.mean() jan_mean = jan_col.mean() # Check valid pixels feb_count_pixels = feb_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=hong_kong, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() jan_count_pixels = jan_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=hong_kong, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Feb Pixels: {feb_count_pixels}, Jan Pixels: {jan_count_pixels}") if feb_count_pixels == 0 or jan_count_pixels == 0: print("C2") else: # Calculate mean NO2 values feb_no2 = feb_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=hong_kong, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() jan_no2 = jan_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=hong_kong, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Feb NO2: {feb_no2:.6f}, Jan NO2: {jan_no2:.6f}") # Validate results if feb_no2 is None or jan_no2 is None or feb_no2 < 0 or jan_no2 < 0: print("C3") else: # Check if February levels decreased compared to January if feb_no2 < jan_no2: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
hong_kong = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [113.8, 22.1],
    [114.5, 22.1],
    [114.5, 22.6],
    [113.8, 22.6],
    [113.8, 22.1]
])

# Period 1: Feb 10-25, 2020
feb_start = '2020-02-10'
feb_end = '2020-02-25'

# Period 2: Jan 1-20, 2020  
jan_start = '2020-01-01'
jan_end = '2020-01-20'

# 2. Data Acquisition
feb_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
    .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) \
    .filterBounds(hong_kong)

jan_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
    .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) \
    .filterBounds(hong_kong)

# Check for empty collections
feb_count = feb_col.size().getInfo()
jan_count = jan_col.size().getInfo()

print(f"Feb Images: {feb_count}, Jan Images: {jan_count}")

if feb_count == 0 or jan_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Create mean composites
    feb_mean = feb_col.mean()
    jan_mean = jan_col.mean()
    
    # Check valid pixels
    feb_count_pixels = feb_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=hong_kong,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    jan_count_pixels = jan_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=hong_kong,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Feb Pixels: {feb_count_pixels}, Jan Pixels: {jan_count_pixels}")
    
    if feb_count_pixels == 0 or jan_count_pixels == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean NO2 values
        feb_no2 = feb_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=hong_kong,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        jan_no2 = jan_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=hong_kong,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Feb NO2: {feb_no2:.6f}, Jan NO2: {jan_no2:.6f}")
        
        # Validate results
        if feb_no2 is None or jan_no2 is None or feb_no2 < 0 or jan_no2 < 0:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Check if February levels decreased compared to January
            if feb_no2 < jan_no2:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
